---
title: "FAQ"
---

**Do I need a GPU?** No. Almost every lab is designed for Colab's free CPU runtime. Only the
Module 12 stretch and one capstone option are designed for a T4 GPU.

**Do I need API keys or paid services?** No. Nothing in the workshop uses a paid API.

**Can I run the labs on my own laptop?** Yes; see [Setup](/setup.qmd#local).

**Is a given lab ready?** The [readiness page](/readiness.qmd) shows which labs have run on
their designed runtime, built from recorded runs only.

{{< include /_includes/readiness-summary.md >}}

**I found a mistake.** Please open an issue on
[GitHub](https://github.com/project-delphi/practical-rl/issues).
